scenario_zh: 你正在应聘一家公司的市场助理岗位。面试官会先让你自我介绍，再追问经历、动机与团队协作。
opening: Thanks for making time today. Before we go into the details, could you tell me a little about yourself and what drew you to this role?
preset_questions: Which part of your current job do you find most rewarding?
Can you walk me through a project you had to deliver under pressure?
How do you usually handle disagreement with a colleague?
What would you say is your weakest area, professionally?
Why would you leave your current position for this one?
How do you decide what to prioritise when several tasks land at once?
Where do you see yourself in three years' time?
Do you have any questions for us about the team or the role?
